posts.title: Replace procmail with a bash script
posts.description: Preface: For a very long time, this was my email setup at home: Mutt : MUA (Mail User Agent) postfix : MTA (Message transfer agent) fetchmail : MRA (Mail retrieval agent) procmail : MDA (Message delivery agent) Procmail was used to sort my email in Maildir folders depending on rules defined in .procmailrc . I’ve replaced my ~/.procmailrc with a bash script. Now my setup is: Mutt : MUA postfix : MT
